objective_value: <float> Total weight of the chosen clique: sum of edge weights c_e over all edges with both endpoints in the clique.
clique_vertices: <list[int]> Sorted list of vertex ids selected into the clique (corresponds to x_v = 1 in the MEWCP formulation).
clique_edges: <list[int, int]> One [u, v] pair per edge whose both endpoints lie in the clique (i.e., y_e = 1). Each pair is given with u < v.
